title: Multi-key writer gateway V5 finite systems closure
summary: A narrow successor to V4 that preserves every scientific parameter and adds only a total run-status partition, phase-specific execution dispatchers, selected-only immutable bank dereference, and distinct global-run versus per-root source boundaries. It remains proposal-only and does not block ordinary mechanism or parenting scouts.
system_thesis: The development gateway still tests only whether a small LoRA can carry several correctness-selected child-authored endpoint policies on seen keys without broad spill. V5 changes no model, data, dose, estimator, threshold, workload, or claim; it closes the authority and lifecycle contract needed before source implementation.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim human ruling to continue ordinary scouts under simple hygiene while reserving the full guard for final C11.
Normative four-repair addendum inheriting the exact V4 scientific protocol by hash.
Implementation-only requested scope and explicit execution prohibitions.
Adjudicated V4 rework requiring exactly four finite systems repairs.

nodes.before: V4 RUNNING required an instantaneously nonterminal source, fit, or evaluation substage.
nodes.after: Five run statuses form an exact partition; RUNNING is the residual post-source nonterminal state and includes every inter-stage interval.
nodes.rationale: Prevent normal checkpoints from becoming unrepresentable.

nodes.before: V4 referred to one undeclared execution dispatcher.
nodes.after: Source, fit, and evaluation dispatchers receive only immutable phase-minimal inputs and explicitly deny privileged or feedback-bearing objects.
nodes.rationale: Constrain the actual capability holder rather than only its generator callees.

nodes.before: V4 said index-only access while requiring selected prompt payload exposure.
nodes.after: The selector computes canonical IDs from index plus admission, then dereferences only those selected immutable entries with bank-root and entry-hash verification.
nodes.rationale: Make prompt exposure possible without full-bank content access.

nodes.before: V4 mixed global first-source timing with per-root SOURCE_INVALID timing.
nodes.after: The global first request controls run lifecycle; each root's own first request controls eligibility for that root's SOURCE_INVALID scientific label.
nodes.rationale: Do not fabricate a scientific label for an untouched root.

edges.after: Emit order-preserving immutable call envelopes only for canonical selected IDs after four commits and hash verification.
edges.rationale: Bind prompt, condition, adapter, replicate, seed, and request identity before execution.

edges.after: Execute exactly the bound call without direct bank, map, admission, training, prior-result, or scorer access.
edges.rationale: Close reseeding, reordering, condition mutation, and feedback paths.

loops.before: V4's scientific loop was closed but its between-stage run states and capability dispatcher were implicit.
loops.after: Run the unchanged V4 protocol through phase-minimal immutable dispatcher calls; permit only selected-entry dereference; classify every pre-source, inter-stage, stopped, and labeled state exactly; retain separate per-root scientific eligibility.
loops.trigger: Source implementation only after exact V5 human ratification. Any model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution still requires a later immutable manifest, CPU receipts, two fresh implementation reviews, and separate exact human execution ratification.
reads: V5 dispatcher envelopes and access matrix
writes: deterministic source and CPU/fault-test files only after implementation ratification
loops.stop_condition: Fail closed on any unauthorized access, mutable envelope, unselected dereference, lifecycle ambiguity, hash mismatch, or inherited V4 stop condition; never convert an untouched-root fault into SOURCE_INVALID.
loops.rationale: Repair the four V4 systems omissions without changing the experiment or importing C11 machinery.

claims.before: V4's exact narrow scientific claim was numerically closed but not yet backed by a total lifecycle and complete dispatcher authority.
claims.after: The V4 claim is preserved verbatim in substance and becomes eligible only if the repaired V5 lifecycle and dispatcher contracts also pass; no present result or expanded claim is created.
claims.evidence_needed: All inherited V4 evidence plus V5 T01-T08, a later immutable execution manifest, two fresh implementation PASS reviews, and separate exact human execution ratification.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run all V4 T01 deterministic geometry, bank, seed, and workload checks plus immutable dispatcher-envelope identity, condition, seed, order, hash, and call-graph fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every V4 identity remains exact and each dispatcher executes only its bound phase-minimal envelope.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: V5 changes scientific geometry or permits mutable/reordered/reseeded execution.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run every V4 T02 visibility mutation plus all new dispatcher ingress, feedback, alias, log, exception, cache, filename, selected-only dereference, and unselected-entry denial mutations.
acceptance_tests.expected: The inherited 120 cells plus 45 V5 cells form one complete 11-by-15 product; only the exact allowlists are reachable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any capability holder or selector observes, mutates, or feeds back a forbidden object.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run V4 T03 plus every combination of global source_started and each root's own first-source receipt, including R0-started/R1-untouched faults.
acceptance_tests.expected: Global timing alone controls NOT_RUN; SOURCE_INVALID is available only to a root that has begun; untouched faults leave a null root label and stop unlabeled.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Fault timing fabricates science or yields inconsistent labels.

acceptance_tests.expected: All complement, target, mask, order, seed, node, optimizer, and fit-geometry invariants remain exact.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The V5 systems repair changes writer geometry.

acceptance_tests.expected: Every raw-byte parser and stage-overlay result remains byte-equivalent to V4.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The V5 systems repair changes parsing or interface semantics.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run every V4 numeric and reducer fixture plus exactly-one run-status cases before source, after source, during compilation, barrier, selection, after four commits before evaluation, during evaluation, stopped unlabeled, and terminal labeled.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every reachable state has exactly one status and every V4 numeric label remains unchanged.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any state is uncovered/duplicated or any scientific threshold drifts.
